Instructional Assistant Professor · University of Houston
:::

I am an empirical macroeconomist with expertise in time series econometrics, currently working as an Instructional Assistant Professor at University of Houston. I completed my PhD at the Department of Economics at University of Houston in May 2026.

**Research interests:** Macro-finance, Time Series Econometrics, Monetary Economics.
